info.name: Water Delivery API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Water Delivery Platform including Phase 1 core features, Phase 1.5 enhanced features, Phase 2 security enhancements, and Phase 3 infrastructure endpoints.

**Phase 1 Features:**
- Authentication & Authorization
- Admin Management
- Product Moderation
- Order Management
- Refund Management
- Dispute Management
- Escalation Management
- Vendor Products
- Store Management
- Product Discovery
- Customer Management
- Commission Management (admin commission rules and calculations)
- Subscription Management (customer recurring delivery subscriptions)
- Wallet Management (customer wallet operations and balance management)
- Enhanced Store Management (comprehensive vendor store operations)

**Phase 2 Security Enhancements:**
- Rider Authentication (OTP-based login, JWT tokens)
- Task Management (accept, pickup, deliver, fail)
- Shift Management (shift end, cash reconciliation)
- Notifications & Support (notification history, support tickets)
- Security Features (rate limiting, session management)

**Phase 3 Infrastructure:**
- Background Worker Status (worker monitoring, queue metrics)
- Cache Management (cache statistics, invalidation)
- Offline Support (connectivity monitoring, sync status)
- System Monitoring (health checks, performance metrics)

**Security Features:**
- JWT-based authentication for all protected endpoints
- Rate limiting on authentication endpoints
- Session management with automatic expiration
- Role-based access control (Admin, Vendor, Customer, Rider)
- Input validation and sanitization
- Error response standardization

**Environment Variables:**
- baseUrl: Base URL for the API server
- adminToken: JWT token for admin operations
- vendorToken: JWT token for vendor operations
- customerToken: JWT token for customer operations
- riderToken: JWT token for rider operations
